remarks: Set back into a private and generous corner lot is this charming home that is filled with lots of beautiful natural light.  Spacious rooms flow gracefully through arched doorways, showcasing meticulously restored hardwood floors adorned with mahogany inlays. Built-in bookcases and abundant windows create an airy, organized atmosphere throughout. The main level features a living room with an inviting cozy wood-burning fireplace with a stone hearth. An expansive archway leads to the dining area and updated kitchen, perfect for entertaining., dining room, kitchen, half bathroom, and office, while a delightful three-season porch offers an ideal spot for relaxation and gatherings. Upstairs, find 2 spacious bedrooms with ample closet space and a full bathroom. A finished lower level provides versatile space for various activities. This home offers the perfect blend of vintage charm and modern functionality, creating an idyllic setting for comfortable living. Conveniently located for shopping, highways, public transportation and minutes to Sono and the Sono Collection Mall.
